rationale.risk-routing: Composite risk thresholds determine allow, deny, sanitize, or human escalation.
rationale.ai-review: Probabilistic safety classifiers independently judge proposed agent actions.
rationale.rules-based-checks: OPA policies deterministically evaluate enriched actions before any side effect.
rationale.formal-methods: A formal FSM specifies invariants, liveness, and model-checkable transitions.
rationale.remediation-gating: Policy-triggered sanitization autonomously rewrites payloads under enforced postconditions.
rationale.hitl-workflow: Escalated actions remain suspended until authorized human approval returns.
rationale.agent-scope-drift: Policy scopes and sequence checks bound off-mandate agent tool use.
rationale.org-governance: Enterprise policy-as-code, roles, tenant scopes, and audit logging form governance apparatus.
rationale.regulatory-compliance: External standards drive thresholds, oversight, traceability, and audit evidence.
rationale.provenance-auditability: Append-only versioned events reconstruct action chains for auditors and forensics.
rationale.framework: Provides a reusable cloud-native runtime governance and enforcement architecture.
rationale.built-system: Authors implemented and evaluated an OPA-based policy-engine prototype.
rationale.general-ai: Governed objects are general agent actions, not AI-generated code.
rationale.agentic: Autonomous agents plan workflows and propose consequential multi-step tool actions.
rationale.metrics: Defines reusable security, privacy, and compliance risk scores and thresholds.
